svg.title: SMC clock distribution
svg.desc: Clock distribution inside the SMC. Six clocks enter on the left: clk_smc_i, clk_ref_i, clk_periph_i, clk_telemetry_i, smc_cpu_jtag_TCK_i and spi_clk_i. clk_smc_i and clk_ref_i run down trunks with one arrow into each of u_smc_base, u_smc_cpu_wrapper and u_smc_peripherals; clk_periph_i and clk_telemetry_i enter u_smc_peripherals, and smc_cpu_jtag_TCK_i enters u_smc_cpu_wrapper. Each logic block is tinted with the colour of the clock that runs it, and a block split into bands runs on several clocks. A clock gate is a tab coloured by the clock it gates, with its instance name in italics. In u_smc_base, u_internal_regs gates the mailbox, the outbound and inbound filter registers and the M-mode, Xvisor and alias remap registers with u_mailbox_cg, u_outbound_filter_reg_cg, u_inbound_filter_reg_cg, u_mmode_remap_cg, u_xvisor_remap_cg and u_alias_remap_cg; u_smc_dfd_wrap gates the DFD and debug bus muxes with u_dfd_clk_gate and generates the CLA time tick from clk_ref_i. u_smc_fabric gates the inbound filter with u_sys_in_filter_cg, the output demux and mux with u_fabric_cg when NO_ADDR_REMAP is 0, and the outbound filter with u_sys_out_filter_cg. u_dma_wrap gates its frontend with u_frontend_cg and its request manager and backend with u_request_maneger_cg; u_zeroer gates its clear FSM with u_axi_clk_gater and its registers with u_zeroer_cg. In u_smc_cpu_wrapper, u_refclk_counter counts clk_ref_i into clk_smc_i, u_debug_clock_gate gates the debug module clock and smc_cpu_jtag_TCK_i clocks the JTAG DTM. In u_smc_peripherals, u_smc_reset_unit and u_smc_peripherals_cdc span the SMC, reference, peripheral and telemetry clocks. u_i2c_clk_periph_gater, u_uart_clk_periph_gater and u_i3c_clk_periph_gater gate clk_periph_i for the I2C, UART and I3C wrappers, and the gated I3C clock also leaves the SMC as gated_clk_periph_i3c_o. u_tel_clk_smc_gater and u_tel_clk_telemetry_gater gate both clocks of the telemetry receiver. The AVSBus clock starts at u_avs_clk_ref_gater and u_avs_clk_periph_gater, passes u_refclk_clkgate or u_apbclk_clkgate, the glitch-free mux u_refclk_apbclk_mux, the test mux u_test_clkmux2_0, the divider u_clk_div and u_avs_bus_clkgate, and leaves through u_smc_padring as avs_clock. spi_clk_i passes through u_smc_padring to its pad.
svg.text: Clock gate, coloured by the clock it gates
